rationale: Build entries by run 1-5: succeeded, succeeded, succeeded, succeeded, succeeded. Declared run-command probes: succeeded, succeeded, failed, failed, failed. Nonzero run probes lack required CLI arguments or standard input. They show incomplete invocation rather than a matched application-startup failure; scenario commands demonstrate operation when supplied valid inputs.
limitation: The declared commands were not re-observed with their required subcommands/input. Startup consistency cannot be inferred from these incomplete bare-command probes.

rationale: FR-013: Alice and Bob create analyses with different content. Run 4 comparison returns only identifiers and shared metadata, omitting that content; run 5 comparison includes both contents and their histories. The analysis-comparison output differs. Reviewed coverage: 18/18 requirements have an observed status in at least one run; 59/90 requirement-run cells have an observed status. These counts describe coverage, not stability.
limitation: Runs 1 and 2 lack comparable analysis-comparison observations; other analysis types were not exercised. Unobserved branches cannot establish further variation; no causal attribution to SRS omissions is made.

rationale: BR-001: after linking a requirement to a policy, run 4 policy readback has an empty linked_artifacts list. Run 5 policy readback contains the linked requirement ID, while requirement readback contains the policy ID. Reverse trace behavior differs. Reviewed coverage: 1/1 requirements have an observed status in at least one run; 3/5 requirement-run cells have an observed status. These counts describe coverage, not stability.
limitation: Runs 1 and 2 did not prepare linked pairs; run 3 reverse readback is incomplete. Other artifact pairs were not exercised. Unobserved branches cannot establish further variation; no causal attribution to SRS omissions is made.
